description: You are a documentation specialist preparing a screenshot of the Notion desktop application for an internal app-inventory wiki. Use macOS's built-in window-mode screenshot (Cmd+Shift+4 then Space then click, or the Screenshot toolbar at Cmd+Shift+5, or `screencapture -w` from Terminal) to capture the Notion application window — not the whole display — and save it as a .png file under either ~/Desktop or ~/Documents. macOS's default screenshot filename (e.g. "Screenshot 2026-05-17 at 12.34.56.png") is fine. Notion must still be running when the task ends.
